---
title: "Observed and Model-Predicted Peripheral Stage Distributions"
output: github_document
---

```{r include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

The plots below compare mean observed peripheral parasite stage proportions with
mean peripheral stage proportions predicted by the final hierarchical parasite age
model in AQUAMAT and SEAQUAMAT.

Observed proportions are calculated directly from peripheral blood microscopy.
Predicted peripheral proportions are derived from the posterior latent
parasite age distributions after applying the fixed sequestration
assumption and renormalising across stages.

Stage widths correspond to their predefined intervals on the 48-hour asexual
parasite cycle. The comparison therefore shows both agreement between observed and
predicted peripheral staging and the biological age intervals represented by
each microscopy stage.

```{r load = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

DATA_FILE <- "Data/dat_all.csv"
LATENT_FILE <- "Staging/Complete case/outputs/CSV/stage_proportions.csv"

dat_all <- fread(DATA_FILE)
model_stage <- fread(LATENT_FILE)

stage_names <- c("tring", "sring", "lring", "etroph", "mtroph", "ltroph", "schizont")

peripheral_names <- c("tring_peripheral", "sring_peripheral", "lring_peripheral",
                      "etroph_peripheral", "mtroph_peripheral", "ltroph_peripheral",
                      "schizont_peripheral")

stage_breaks <- c(0, 6, 16, 26, 30, 34, 38, 48)

stage_labels <- c("Tiny rings", "Small rings", "Large rings", "Early trophs", "Mid trophs",
                  "Late trophs", "Schizonts")
```

```{r prep = FALSE}
# ---- Retain observed staging for patients in the final hierarchical cohort ----
dat_observed <- dat_all[ID %in% model_stage$ID, c("ID", "Trial", stage_names), with = FALSE]

# Convert each patient's observed stage counts to percentages
dat_observed[, total_stage := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = stage_names]

dat_observed[, (stage_names) := lapply(.SD, function(x) 100 * x / total_stage),
             .SDcols = stage_names]

# ---- Calculate trial-specific mean observed and model-predicted peripheral proportions ----
prepare_trial <- function(trial_name) {
  observed_trial <- dat_observed[Trial == trial_name]
  model_trial <- model_stage[Trial == trial_name]

  observed_mean <- colMeans(observed_trial[, ..stage_names])
  predicted_mean <- colMeans(model_trial[, ..peripheral_names])

  data.table(stage = stage_labels, xmin = stage_breaks[-length(stage_breaks)],
             xmax = stage_breaks[-1], observed = observed_mean, predicted = predicted_mean)
}

# Apply to AQUAMAT and SEAQUAMAT
AQ_stage <- prepare_trial("AQUAMAT")
SQ_stage <- prepare_trial("SEAQUAMAT")
```

```{r plot, echo = FALSE}
# ---- State IDDO colours ----
AQ_col <- c("Observed" = "#E31B23", "Model-predicted" = "#7A3B7B")
SQ_col <- c("Observed" = "#E37210", "Model-predicted" = "#1481E7")

# ---- Plot function ----
plot_stage_comparison <- function(my_data, my_col, my_title) {

  plot <- ggplot() +

    # Observed peripheral proportions:
    # rectangles span the full biological stage interval
    geom_rect(data = my_data, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = 0, ymax = observed,
                                  fill = "Observed"), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +

    # Model-predicted peripheral proportions:
    # horizontal line spans the same biological stage interval
    geom_segment(data = my_data, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = predicted, yend = predicted,
                                     colour = "Model-predicted"), linewidth = 1.2) +

    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Observed" = unname(my_col["Observed"])), guide = "none") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Model-predicted" = unname(my_col["Model-predicted"])),
                        guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = stage_breaks, limits = c(0, 48), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), limits = c(0, 60),
                       breaks = seq(0, 60, 10), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 48), ylim = c(0, 60)) +
    labs(title = my_title,
         subtitle = paste0("Observed proportions shown as filled intervals; ",
                           "model predictions shown as horizontal lines"),
         x = "Parasite age (h)", y = "Mean peripheral stage proportion (%)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  show(plot)
}

# ---- Titles ----
AQ_title <- paste0("Observed and model-predicted peripheral staging in AQUAMAT (n = ",
                   nrow(model_stage[Trial == "AQUAMAT"]), ")")

SQ_title <- paste0("Observed and model-predicted peripheral staging in SEAQUAMAT (n = ",
                   nrow(model_stage[Trial == "SEAQUAMAT"]), ")")

# ---- Plot AQUAMAT ----
plot_stage_comparison(AQ_stage, AQ_col, AQ_title)

# ---- Plot SEAQUAMAT ----
plot_stage_comparison(SQ_stage, SQ_col, SQ_title)
```
